title: Find the number of distinct non-textless cards illustrated by 'Volkan Baǵa'
question: Find the number of distinct non-textless cards illustrated by 'Volkan Baǵa' that have at least one ruling issued after January 1, 2020, and whose frame effect is among those that appear more than once in the set of incredibly powerful foils—defined as cards where both cardKingdomId and cardKingdomFoilId are not null.

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_001")
FROM cards AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'Volkan Baǵa'
  AND T1."XCL_022" = 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM rulings AS T2
    WHERE T2."XCL_090" = T1."XCL_072"
      AND T2."XCL_088" > '2020-01-01'
  )
  AND T1."XCL_018" IN (
    SELECT T3."XCL_018"
    FROM cards AS T3
    WHERE T3."XCL_007" IS NOT NULL
      AND T3."XCL_006" IS NOT NULL
      AND T3."XCL_018" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY T3."XCL_018"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
  )
